content: The use of high-intensity and moderate-intensity statins has been shown to effectively lower LDL cholesterol levels. For patients who do not achieve their target LDL cholesterol levels with statin therapy alone, the addition of ezetimibe to the statin regimen can provide further reductions in LDL cholesterol. Similarly, the incorporation of PCSK9 inhibitors alongside statins is another effective strategy to achieve additional lowering of LDL cholesterol. Both approaches have been demonstrated to reduce cardiovascular risks associated with elevated LDL cholesterol levels.
